newsitem.title: USA: Revco says Big B bid antitrust review ends.
newsitem.headline: Revco says Big B bid antitrust review ends.

text.p: Revco D.S. Inc said the federal antitrust review of its $15 per share unwelcome bid for Big B Inc has expired with no request for additional information or documents.
The Hart-Scott-Rodino review period's expiration allows Revco to proceed with the Big B takeover attempt with no further federal antitrust review, Revco said.

"We are pleased that the government has concluded its Hart-Scott-Rodino inquiry without the need for a second request. The only thing now depriving Big B's shareholders of the opportunity to receive prompt value for their shares is Big B's poison pill," said D. Dwayne Hoven, Revco chief executive.
On September 23 Big B said that its board unanimously rejected the offer as "inadequate from a financial point of view."
Big B then also announced the adoption of a "poison pill" shareholder rights plan to defend against Revco's bid.
In midmorning Nasdaq trade, Big B shares slipped 1/16 to 16-3/4 while Revco stock gained 5/8 to 27-7/8 on the New York Stock Exchange.
